title: Chapter 438
text:
Han Xiao's lips curled up. Before informing Chen Xing, he had bought a type of Mind Poison from another planet and smeared it on the statue. This was a poison that specifically targeted the mind. Once the psychic energy released from the body came into contact with the poison, it would cause a backlash and damage. Furthermore, the psychic resistance would plummet. It was effective against psychic Espers, Mages, and Psychics.

Chen Xing had already been injured, and he had sucked the statue dry in one breath. His mind had already become weak, and he had also been poisoned. With all these factors stacked together, his resistance had been greatly reduced. These three mental attacks had directly shattered his consciousness, causing him to suffer a severe backlash.

Chen Xing was a Grade B, but Psychics were more fragile. Han Xiao did not dare to use Flaming Will, fearing that he might be unlucky and kill Chen Xing in an instant.

Blood flowed out of his mouth and nose as he fell to the ground and broke into pieces. Chen Xing had basically lost all ability to resist. He stared at Han Xiao with an unwilling expression.

In a trance, Chen Xing's expression seemed to have become very calm for a moment, but upon closer inspection, it seemed like an illusion.

"Why did you attack me …" Chen Xing gritted his teeth. "Did you accept the mission to assassinate me?"

Han Xiao did not answer. He grabbed Chen Xing's hair and slammed him on the ground, knocking him unconscious.

Explaining was the job of a villain. He was a decent person!

"Old Hermes, come back. Let's retreat!"

"Thanks to you, I might be a little busy now …" Herlous' voice came from outside the door. He blocked wave after wave of guards and fought fiercely.

Han Xiao grabbed Chen Xing's clothes and threw him to the three Volga brothers. Then, he faced the wall of the hotel with both hands and fired a full blast.

Boom!

The gray shockwave blasted through the wall. Bricks and steel bars flew everywhere, and the smell of dust filled the air. There was a large hole in the outer wall of the hotel. The outside was a few hundred meters above the ground, and more than a hundred meters below, there was an endless stream of hovering cars.

Han Xiao saw the opportunity and jumped, smashing through a hovering car. He looked more like a woman before, but now he looked like a pure man. He turned to look at Han Xiao and smiled calmly, not at all the angry look he had just now.

"Hello, I've been looking at you. Although you attacked me to kidnap me, I'm still very grateful that you gave me a chance to come out and take a breather."

His voice was mellow and gentle, completely different from his usual feminine tone. He did not seem like the same person.

"You, you …" Herlous was shocked.

"Chen Xing" nodded with a gentle smile.
